notes: Breadboard bank naming follows the row letters in the image: the upper half is labelled rows f-j, so those holes are written as bank 'b' (e.g. '6b.g'). The catalogue text says 't' is the upper half, which conflicts with the image labels.

Rail hole numbers are estimated from the image. The top '+' rail is tp and the top '-' rail is tn. The red wire from 5V lands in the first hole of the + rail, and the black wire from GND lands in the third hole of the - rail. The red wire that feeds the photoresistor starts at the 5th + rail hole. The black wire that feeds the resistor starts at about the 11th - rail hole.

The photoresistor spans columns 6 and 10 in row g. The red wire from the + rail lands in 6b.h, which is the same strip as the photoresistor's first leg. The blue A0 wire lands in column 10, row i, which is the same strip as the photoresistor's second leg and the resistor's first leg. This is the voltage divider midpoint.
The 10k resistor goes from column 10 to column 13 in row h. A black wire links column 13 to the - rail, and the - rail goes to Arduino GND.
The Arduino GND pin used is assumed to be GND.1, the first GND pin in the power header.
The schematic matches the image: 5V to the photoresistor, then the midpoint to A0, then the 10k resistor to GND.
